text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah, Trainer-san! 
……No, I was just about to leave.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thanks again for the training today. 
I'm looking forward to tomorrow too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Then, see you～!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ——『Dear Cesario』

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
『It's been starting to get warmer here,
how about over there? 
During our last day off,
Team <Ascella> went flower viewing!』

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
——『And photos,
I'm sending you a lot of them again! 
And surprise!
The ever popular puppy series makes a
return!』

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Alright♪ Now to attach the photos～ 
……Ah.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (This one, I took earlier this evening——)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
……No matter how many times I look,
it really……looks the same.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Nothing was captured——

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: One, two, threeeeee……! Huu, allll～right……!

……Alright,
it's about time to start training. 
Team <Ascella>, let's begin!

……Alright,
it's about time to start training. 
Team <Ascella>, let's begin!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Okay, Team <Ascella>! 
We're starting training now. Gather up!

text_block_list.name: Antenna-haired Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Heeere～ number one is here～. 
……Fuwaah……just a little sleep deprived～……

text_block_list.name: Single Knot Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Stupid,
are you stupid?
It's good to be honest though! 
……Oh, uh, I'm ready to go too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft, ready to go! 
Motivated, and fully charged.

Yeaah～! 
Me too～, fully charged～～～☆

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ……Eh?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ……Huh?

text_block_list.name: <Ascella> Members
text_block_list.text: Who?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Fuufuufuu～…… Eehehehehehe～～～!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ever since birth, a suuuuuper genius～! 
An Uma Musume brighter and sparklier than
any before or after♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: That's me——Fusaichi Pandora♡

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Mom
text_block_list.text:
Look～, Pan-chan, a brand new dress! 
You said you were wanting one right?
Mama found a really lovely one～!

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Dad
text_block_list.text:
And from Papa,
a brand new pair of shoes! You really 
wanted one with ribbons didn't you? Ah,
next time 
let's go find a perfect pair of socks to go
with them～!

text_block_list.name: Young Pandora
text_block_list.text:
——Amazing～! Races seem like lots of fun～! 
Hey, hey, I want to try too! Let me,
let me～♡

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Dad
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see, so Pan-chan wants to try racing,
huh～! 
Alright,
let's find a club tomorrow!
Or even right now!

text_block_list.name: Young Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa……Hehe, goal! 
I was number one♪

text_block_list.name: Club Trainer
text_block_list.text:
A time like this at that age……!
She has some amazing potential! 
Fusaichi Pandora……You really are what can
be called a genius!

text_block_list.name: Young Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……! Genius……♡

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaah,
it really is Tracen Academy's uniform……! 
So awesome!
I heard the entrance exams are really 
hard,
but you passed with flying colors didn't
you?

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
No way!
If it's Pandora-chan then her debut 
and even G1's seem like they'd be easy
wins～!

text_block_list.name: Young Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eh～? Ehehe…… Ehehehehee～, I wonder? 
Maybe♡ After all——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I'm a genius, you know♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Know what else? Even in the Twinkle Series,
if 
anyone was going to do something suuuuuper～
amazing 
that nobody else in history has done
before——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think it has to be me, me,
meeeee～～～～?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And so! It's the super amazing,
super lovely 
Team <Ascella> Newcomer, Fusaichi Pandora♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Glad to be here with you! 
Especially～……Ku-chan-senpai♡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, eh, Pandora-san……? 
Wait, senpai? ……Eeeeeeh?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Eh, ah, well! Rather than know her——

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Stop right there, Pandora———!
What the hell are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Pyaa?

text_block_list.name: Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I'm really sorry about that,
Team <Ascella>. 
That……our Fusaichi Pandora was causing
trouble.

But, I see.
Fusaichi Pandora transferring to our team 
was already something you all came to an
agreement on.

text_block_list.name: Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and tomorrow,
we were planning to formally speak to you
about it…… 
But the girl in question was getting a little
ahead of herself.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hau…… I'm sowwy～……

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha…… Sorry that things turned out like
this.
Still, <Ascella>,
could we ask you to reconsider?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Please think about taking in Fusaichi
Pandora.
……Now then,
you can properly tell them yourself too,
right, Pandora?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
O-Osu! ……Um,
well. I'm not doing this on a whim!
I really thought it through and decided to
transfer teams!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
With Ku-chan-senpai——
Because I want to run alongside Rhein
Kraft-chan!
